She is a past president of the Fifth Judicial District Bar, a longtime community volunteer, and is described as a leader among North Carolina judges. *([Melinda Crouch](https://localvoterguide.com/nc/statewide/nc-district-court-judge-district-6-seat-3/melinda-crouch).)* *(Sources: [Re-elect Judge Melinda Crouch](https://judgecrouch.com/); [North Carolina's 2026 Judicial Races to Monitor](https://tarheelstatereport.com/north-carolina-judicial-races/).)* --- *Election day is November 3, 2026.
